summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in camelotlabs-utils@0.0.0-stage
details: Package camelotlabs-utils version 0.0.0-stage contains two files and no detectable malicious behavior. There are no install or lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content, no reads of installer secrets such as ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, or environment credentials, no network beacons to attacker-controlled endpoints, no silent-relay of caller-supplied data, no backdoor or persistence mechanism, and no dependency-chain dropper indicators. The version string suggests a pre-release or staging placeholder publication.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
